Public identity

The 561 Group

The 561 Group is the public facade of a Union of independent enterprises that research, design, publish, and operate technical infrastructure for long-horizon autonomy, collective intelligence, Black Liberation, Indigenous Sovereignty, and strategic prosperity.

We publish reusable knowledge and source code through the 561 Group GitHub organization. Operated services remain owned and settled by their operating enterprises rather than by this website.

Public work

Koios.News is a sibling public enterprise in the same federation, publishing independently under its own name and source. Market.561.group is the commercial catalog for currently published offers and their operating boundaries.

Browse publications and public surfaces. A conservative machine-readable identity graph is available at /entity-graph.json.

Publications and public surfaces

This page lists public surfaces whose relationship is supported by current first-party 561 sources. It is intentionally narrower than an internal project inventory.

Koios.News

General news with systems-analysis depth. Koios.News publishes independently under its own name and source as a sibling public enterprise in the same federation.

Canonical: https://koios.news/

561 Group Market

A catalog of independently operated offers. The catalog describes owners, boundaries, prices, and evidence; the operating enterprises settle their own services.

Canonical: https://market.561.group/

561 Group source

Public repositories for reusable source code and references published by the 561 Group organization.

Canonical account: https://github.com/561-group
